lines: I still <pulse>remember</pulse> you trying to take my {stolen_stack}.
That {stolen_item} from the {stolen_container}? I have not forgotten.
You put your hands on village stores once. I am <pulse>watching</pulse> them now.
Trust is counted in small things. Last time, it was counted in {stolen_stack}.
I remember the {stolen_container}, the missing {stolen_item}, and your face beside both.
If you came to repay what happened with the {stolen_item}, start by keeping your hands visible.
<aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua> told me about you stealing {stolen_stack}. Not cool.
Word travels faster than full pockets. <aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua> <pulse>saw</pulse> the {stolen_item}.
Around here, a missing {stolen_item} becomes everybody's story.
<aqua>{theft_witness_possessive}</aqua> <shake>warning</shake> reached more doors than you opened.
People here share bread, tools, and warnings. You became the warning after that {stolen_stack}.
I was not there, but <aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua> was. That is enough for me to watch the {stolen_container}.
